 GAME THREAD: Miami Heat (4-6) look to finish road trip strong against struggling Utah Jazz (1-9)
 58 Comments 
 / By 
 Surya Fernandez 
 / November 10, 2026 
 The Miami Heat wrap up their five-game Western Conference road trip tonight with a visit to the Utah Jazz at the Delta Center, looking to build on Sunday’s victory over the Sacramento Kings.
 Miami enters the matchup with a 4-6 record after securing a 114-108 win over Sacramento, improving to 2-2 on its road trip. Giannis Antetokounmpo led the way with 29 points and 14 rebounds, while Klay Thompson contributed 23 points.
 But perhaps the biggest development came from Erik Spoelstra’s decision to shake up the starting lineup.
 Pelle Larsson replaced Andrew Wiggins in the starting five against Sacramento, providing Miami with a different look and some much-needed energy. The adjustment paid off, and it will be interesting to see whether Spoelstra sticks with the same combination tonight.
 The Jazz, meanwhile, have struggled mightily to open the 2026-27 NBA season. Utah enters the game at 1-9, having lost eight consecutive games, and will be without several key players due to injuries.
 Among those sidelined are Keyonte George, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic, while Lauri Markkanen has also been dealing with a wrist injury. Rookie guard Darryn Peterson remains a bright spot for Utah, coming off a career-high 26-point performance against Minnesota.
 For Miami, tonight represents an excellent opportunity to continue building chemistry, establish a stronger defensive identity and close out the road trip with a winning record.
 After an 0-4 start, a victory tonight would give the Heat five wins in their last seven games.
 Can Giannis, Bam Adebayo and the rest of the Heat take care of business in Salt Lake City?
 STARTING LINEUPS
 Miami Heat 
 Davion Mitchell, PG
 Klay Thompson, SG
 Pelle Larsson, SF
 Giannis Antetokounmpo, PF
 Bam Adebayo, C
 Utah Jazz 
 Josh Okogie, G
 Darryn Peterson, G
 Josh Green, SF

 Jaxson Hayes, C
 INJURY REPORT / PLAYER AVAILABILITY
 Miami Heat 
 Giannis Antetokounmpo — AVAILABLE (right wrist sprain)
 Utah Jazz 
 Lauri Markkanen — OUT (right wrist sprain)
 Keyonte George — OUT (right ankle sprain)
 Jaren Jackson Jr. — OUT (right knee MCL tear)
 Jusuf Nurkic — OUT (right foot injury)
 Trey Alexander — OUT (G League/two-way assignment)
 Kobe Bufkin — OUT (G League/two-way assignment)
 Harrison Ingram — OUT (G League/two-way assignment)
 GAME INFO
 Matchup:  Miami Heat (4-6) at Utah Jazz (1-9)
 Date:  Tuesday, November 10, 2026
 Time:  9:00 PM ET / 7:00 PM MT
 Location:  Delta Center — Salt Lake City, Utah
 TV:  WPLG Local 10 / Local 10+ (South Florida), KJZZ-TV / Jazz+ (Utah)
 Radio:  560 AM WQAM / 104.3 FM (South Florida)
 The Heat have an opportunity to finish their West Coast trip on a high note and continue building momentum before returning home.
 Will Miami make it two straight victories and climb closer to the .500 mark?
 Join the conversation below, share your reactions throughout the game and cheer on the Heat with the Hot Hot Hoops community!
